scheme_name: Subsistence and Transport Allowance to Disabled Students for Pursuing Education in Computer and Management
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
Student must be studying a Computer or Management subject/course at a government college
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of course fees along with a monthly subsistence allowance of ₹1,500 and a transport allowance of ₹500 (₹300 in municipal council areas).
